visual_review.notes: Independent static visual review of all104 authored poses against original fire elemental context, every camera direction and every mandatory role, including corrected E travelC. Preserve fire-orange/yellow white-hot pointed face, plated chest/back, clawed arms continuously attached into a coiled fire vortex without human legs. E/W opposing profiles, S face, NW/NE back-dominant three-quarter torso and N back without frontal face. Distinct shoulder/elbow/claw articulation and torso/vortex phase changes rather than translated stills. Attack gathers curled hands, releases into an extended claw gesture, and retracts; N release opens arms laterally while head/torso remain UP, so actual Main UP magic target/projectile alignment is specifically required before completion. Hit recoil and recovery, three-stage death folding into a low coherent nonempty ground corpse remain distinct and connected. All104 visible/raw hashes unique, all source poses used exactly once, strict analyze and complete-region checks PASS with no count/threshold change. Raw RGB fire fog outside crops has alpha<=8 and no pixels alpha>10, so alpha composites do not show detached particles. Six virtual canvases [512,456,632,560,552,584] reviewed from S face and N upper-back anatomical landmarks, not collapsed height, and normalized whole-body comparison. All104 base/corpse anchors based actual alpha>100 bottom four rows. Newly authored2D, not recovered originals. This is approval for Main validation only; actualMain 8direction5role combat/death/drop/pickup, compatibility and display-height approval remain pending. Existing magic/floatingtrue/visualheight86/attack_hit_ratio0.52 settings must remain.
